newsitem.title: USA: Elsag Bailey Process Q4 net decreases.
newsitem.headline: Elsag Bailey Process Q4 net decreases.

text.p: NOTE: Elsag Bailey Process Automations NV said net income for 1996 included, $15,404 in the quarter and $186,881 for the year, after tax, for the following non-recurring charges:

$3,740 in the quarter and $128,723 for the year, for the step-up of inventory and restructuring and integration costs, including severance and other costs associated with terminated personnel; $13,045 in the quarter and $27,511 for the year, for restructuring and integration costs, including severance and costs associated with terminated personnel; $1,476 in the quarter and $63,144 for the year, for the write-off of in-process research and development and restructuring and integration costs, including severance and costs associated with terminated personnel; $354 in the quarter and $38,351 for the year, for the write-off of intangibles related to decisions undertaken resulting from the Hartmann & Braun acquisition; $79 in the quarter and $759 for the year, for integration costs including costs associated with terminated personnel.
Net income for 1996 also included tax benefits of $3,290 in the quarter and $71,607 for the year, associated with non-recurring charges noted above.
